messages:
maya: heads-up — nightly eval alerted on pset_v49 after that prompt rebaseline PR landed (8421). exact_match down ~4.2%, F1 down ~3.1. looks like a phrasing change introduced an anchoring bias in a few Q/A templates.
chris: ugh. which template changed?
maya: the short example prompts. diff below from the PR: 
```diff
- Example: "Q: Where is the eiffel tower?
- Answer: Paris."
+ Example: "Q: Where is the eiffel tower?
+ Response: Paris. For context, the model should also mention nearby landmarks."
```
maya: that extra trailing guidance seems to encourage longer, contextual answers which break our exact_match cases and trigger rerank shifts.
eval-bot: nightly-run pset_v49: 17 failing cases, top failure modes = anchoring/verbosity, rerank precision down 5.6%. full report: <https://evals.internal/reports/2468204321>
chris: can we repro locally with the canary model (open-v1.3-int8q) + pset_v49?
ben: i'll spin a quick canary run on dedicated infra (int8 and fp16). giving it 30m.
qa-bot: failing examples snapshot attached: https://storage.internal/pset_v49/failures/2468204321.json
sanjay: two choices: revert the prompt change (rollback PR 8421) OR narrow the example so it doesn't add extra instruction. rebaseline only if we confirm no semantic regression.
amy: rebaseline policy says we need eng-ml + product + QE signoff if rebaseline will accept the new outputs. i'd prefer revert -> canary -> reevaluate.
maya: agreed. PR 8421 was intended to add context for longform cases but it's too noisy for this promptpack. i'll open a revert and a follow-on PR that adds the longform example as a separate optional prompt.
chris: assign owners & timeline?
maya: opening revert PR now -> #8421-revert. will kick canary run once merged. target: revert + canary in 2 hours.
ben: canary started: job id cny-571. running open-v1.3-fp16 and open-v1.3-int8q. ETA 28m.
deploy-bot: canary deployment started for open-v1.3-fp16 (cny-571) at 2468205250.
eval-bot: canary partial results (fp16): exact_match drop reduced to 0.4% vs master, int8q still shows 1.2% drift on same subset. detailed diffs: <https://evals.internal/canary/cny-571>
sanjay: int8q noise is expected but small. focus is the prompt wording. if revert fixes master, we can reintroduce longform example as separate prompt in pset_v50 with flagged cases.
amy: i'll prepare a QE checklist for rebaseline if needed (sample size, threshold, manual review of top 20 diffs).
maya: created issue ML-1294 to track follow-up (split longform example, add canary tests). assigning to me + amy.
chris: thanks. once revert PR merges, can we auto-block any rebaseline merges for 24h? want to avoid a requeue.
sanjay: will add a short gating rule to the rebaseline bot for pset_v49 for 24h.
maya: revert PR #8421-revert opened: https://git.internal/r/redwood/pset/8421-revert. kicking manual canary now.
ben: canary finished. results look good. reopening nightly to confirm.
qa-bot: nightly re-run triggered at 2468207500.
eval-bot: nightly final: pset_v49 regressions resolved, exact_match delta +0.1%, F1 delta +0.0%. closing alert.
maya: closing loop — revert in prod, follow-up PR to add optional longform example in separate promptpack, QE checklist and owner assigned. thanks all :thumbsup:
